answer.rationale: Negotiate an incumbent bridge or tightly limited renewal against the low-cost quote. This offers a path toward the spend mandate while avoiding an immediate migration with the line at 94% volume and no buffer. Verify c4 to confirm incumbent concessions were materially repeatable and c2 to determine whether the prior low-cost switch also maintained delivery performance, which the consolidated memory does not establish. If negotiation cannot close the gap, the verified switch record should inform the next review.
